summary: The reported diagnostic counts and source-closure module split agree with their frozen receipts, and the retained timeout substantiates the failed-witness disclosure. Neither those records nor the prior external-source inspection is promoted into independent reproduction or a formal I27 proof. No citation or numerical-provenance revision is needed.

checks.scope: Diagnostic count provenance and arithmetic robustness
checks.method: Parsed the two frozen diagnostic JSON files; recomputed their SHA256 values, histogram and support-stratum totals, and binomial(28,4); compared to Section 6.
checks.observation: Both hashes match the snapshot. The histograms agree and sum to 156,960; the support strata have the same total. There are 22 nonempty cases, with maximum candidate count five, while binomial(28,4)=20,475. This is a consistency audit of recorded results, not a rerun or proof that the normalization covers every actual family. The manuscript preserves that limitation.

checks.method: Read and hash-check the closure and failed-witness receipts, count unique fresh/reused module names and compare Sections 5–7 with the previously verified external Proposition 6.7 and Section 8.
checks.observation: The closure lists 63 fresh and 98 reused modules with no overlap, totaling 161. The failed witness records exit 124 after a 100-second timeout. The manuscript describes these at their actual assurance levels and still places the external enumerative I27 theorem outside local Lean verification. I did not rebuild Lean or rerun the external search in this phase. External scope reference: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.06175v1#S8.
